description: This file defines Swagger API response and request models for GL Accounts in the Fineract accounting module, including classes for responses, requests, and templates related to GL Accounts.

classes.name: GetGLAccountsResponse
classes.description: Response model for retrieving GL Account details.

classes.name: GetGLAccountsTemplateResponse

classes.name: PostGLAccountsResponse

classes.name: PutGLAccountsRequest
